lines.en: Eva, has the report been finished yet? The deadline has been moved twice, and the client is losing patience.
lines.pt: Eva, o relatório já foi terminado? O prazo foi adiado duas vezes, e o cliente está perdendo a paciência.

lines.en: It has just been finished. The last figures have been checked twice, so we can send it now.
lines.pt: Acabou de ser terminado. Os últimos números foram conferidos duas vezes, então podemos enviá-lo agora.

lines.en: Great. Have the new contracts been signed? Our lawyer says they have been delayed again.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Os novos contratos já foram assinados? Nosso advogado diz que foram atrasados de novo.

lines.en: Not all of them. Two have been signed, but one has been returned with several mistakes.
lines.pt: Nem todos. Dois foram assinados, mas um foi devolvido com vários erros.

lines.en: Typical. Has the budget been approved by the board, or are we still waiting?
lines.pt: Típico. O orçamento já foi aprovado pela diretoria, ou ainda estamos esperando?

lines.en: It has been approved, although several cuts have been made to the marketing plan.
lines.pt: Foi aprovado, embora vários cortes tenham sido feitos no plano de marketing.

lines.en: That is a pity. Have the staff been told yet? Some of them have been worried for weeks.
lines.pt: Que pena. A equipe já foi informada? Alguns estão preocupados há semanas.

lines.en: An email has been sent this morning, and a meeting has been arranged for three o’clock.
lines.pt: Um e-mail foi enviado esta manhã, e uma reunião foi marcada para as três horas.

lines.en: Good. I hope the room has been booked, because last time nothing was prepared properly.
lines.pt: Bom. Espero que a sala tenha sido reservada, porque da última vez nada foi preparado direito.

lines.en: Don’t worry. The room has been booked, and the coffee has been ordered as well.
lines.pt: Não se preocupe. A sala foi reservada, e o café também foi encomendado.

lines.en: Perfect. Then everything that needed to be done has been done. Let’s go.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Então tudo o que precisava ser feito já foi feito. Vamos.

work.note: “Harriet the Spy” (Harriet, a Espiã) é um romance infantil de 1964 de Louise Fitzhugh sobre uma menina de Nova York que anota no caderno tudo o que observa nos vizinhos. A aula usa essas descrições para praticar particípios que substituem orações relativas: the man standing there.

facts.label: Passivo perfeito
facts.sub: Use has been (singular) e have been (plural) + particípio para o resultado agora. Pergunta: Has it been done? Negativa: It hasn’t been done yet.

facts.label: Passivo perfeito
facts.sub: Use has been com singular e have been com plural, sempre com o particípio: The report has been finished. The contracts have been signed. Mostra que o resultado importa agora.

facts.label: Has / Have + sujeito + been
facts.sub: Na pergunta, has ou have vai antes do sujeito: Has the budget been approved? Have the staff been told yet? Responda curto: Yes, it has. No, they haven’t.

facts.sub: Já combinam bem com o passivo perfeito: It has already been done. It hasn’t been sent yet. It has just been approved. Já, ainda não, acabou de.

facts.label: been é obrigatório
facts.sub: Não esqueça been: The room has been booked, nunca The room has booked. Sem been, a frase fica ativa e muda de sentido. Com o agente, use by: signed by the manager.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The report has been finished” focuses on the result now.
items.why: Yes, it is present perfect passive.

items.s: We say “The contracts has been signed”.
“Has the budget been approved?” is a correct question.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The report has been finished” focuses on the result now. → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is present perfect passive.)
We say “The contracts has been signed”. → Falso (Plural: have been signed.)
“Has the budget been approved?” is a correct question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: The passive perfect uses been before the participle.

pages.instruction: Mais uma rodada: decida e explique.

answers: The passive perfect uses been before the participle. → Verdadeiro (has been + participle.)
We say “It has been finish”. → Falso (We say has been finished.)

pages.title: Before the big meeting · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eight in the morning in a tall office building in Melbourne. Trams ring their bells in the street below. Bill has a long list of things to check. His colleague Eva works at the next desk. A big meeting with a client starts at three. Bill wants to know what has been done.

“Eva, has the report been finished yet? The deadline has been moved twice, and the client is losing patience.” says Bill. “It has just been finished. The last figures have been checked twice, so we can send it now.” says Eva. “Great. Have the new contracts been signed? Our lawyer says they have been delayed again.” says Bill.
